router.pin: Pin the commit that carries this file. The tests in cmd/epp/runner and pkg/embed fail at any commit where a listed file stops being accepted or stops behaving as stated here.

policies.name: default
policies.summary: The router's built-in configuration: queue-scorer 2, kv-cache-utilization-scorer 2, prefix-cache-scorer 3, max-score-picker.
policies.built_in: A router given no configuration runs exactly this; default.yaml is that configuration written as a file and a test shows the two give the same effective configuration.
policies.pd_note: No P/D form exists. It has no prefill or decode profile, no role filter and no disaggregation handler, so in a pool that mixes roles it treats every endpoint as one pool and never names a prefill endpoint (test).
policies.endpoint_choice: Highest weighted score; endpoints with equal scores are tied (see round-robin for what a tie does).

knobs.effective_when: read only while matchLengthWeight is above 0 (scorer/prefix/plugin.go Config)

knobs.note: The producer is created by the router when no producer is configured (cmd/epp/runner/runner.go:749); a sweep that sets this adds the plugin to the file.
A value below 64 is raised to 64 at request time.

ineffective_parameters.reason: Deprecated; it applies only when maxPrefixTokensToMatch is 0 (approximateprefix/plugin.go resolveMaxBlocks). The router's default for maxPrefixTokensToMatch is 131072 and pd-prefix-based sets 16384, so this value is never read. Sweep maxPrefixTokensToMatch.

ineffective_parameters.note: The picker is added by the loader when the configuration names none.
ineffective_parameters.reason: The router's picker would hand the gateway its best N endpoints; the hosted boundary keeps the first of the comma-separated list for the decode pick and for the prefill pick (pkg/embed/route.go decide: Endpoint and Prefill are element 0), and the embed contract carries one endpoint per decision. A value above 1 therefore changes nothing the host sees. The value 1 is the only modelled one.

policies.name: round-robin
policies.summary: max-score-picker with no scorer in the profile.
policies.endpoint_choice: Every candidate has score 0, so all are tied. The picker rotates the tied candidates by a counter, but the candidates reach it in a seeded random order in a hosted runtime (pkg/epp/scheduling/scheduler_profile.go:363-370) and in Go map order otherwise (scheduler_profile.go:358-362). A rotation of a random order is a random order.
policies.measured: In a hosted runtime every endpoint of an even-sized pool is chosen (an even pool does not see only every other endpoint), the choice is not a fixed cycle, and counts are close to equal but not equal to within one. Outside hosting the choice is not a fixed cycle either. The router at this commit has no policy that gives strict per-request rotation over endpoints; the policy behaves as the random picker does.
policies.composition_source: No router sample states this configuration. It is composed from the picker README (pkg/epp/framework/plugins/scheduling/picker/maxscore/README.md:14,19) and the P/D profile pair of the router's well-known configuration (test/integration/epp/wellknown_configs_test.go:108-135).

pd_decider.not_a_knob: Swapping the decider is not one edit. prefix-based-pd-decider reads a prefix match from approx-prefix-cache-producer, so the file needs that producer, a prefix-cache-scorer in both profiles, and a nonCachedTokens above 0 (its default 0 never disaggregates); replacing only the name makes the file fail to load.
pd_decider.variant_note: pd-prefix-based is that complete file. It scores with prefix-cache-scorer 2 and queue-scorer 1, so it is a different policy from this one, not this policy with another decider.

policies.name: least-active-requests
policies.summary: active-request-scorer over the in-flight counts of inflight-load-producer, then max-score-picker.
policies.endpoint_choice: The endpoint with the fewest in-flight requests scores highest. Endpoints with equal counts are tied and the tie is broken as in round-robin, that is at random.
policies.composition_source: pkg/epp/framework/plugins/scheduling/scorer/activerequest/README.md:3-7 and the profile pair of the router's well-known configuration (test/integration/epp/wellknown_configs_test.go:108-135). The router creates inflight-load-producer when none is configured (cmd/epp/runner/runner.go:750); the files name it so that a sweep can set its parameters.

knobs.effective_when: changes the choice when an endpoint holds in-flight requests up to the threshold: it then scores like an idle one

in a file whose only scorer is the active-request-scorer only the value 0 can change a choice: it makes every busy endpoint score 0, so they tie; any other value scales the scores and keeps their order

ineffective_parameters.note: Changes token counts only; the active-request scorer reads request counts.
ineffective_parameters.reason: It adds estimated output tokens to the in-flight load's Tokens figure. The active-request-scorer reads the request count (InFlightLoad.Requests, scorer/activerequest/active_request.go requestCount), and no other plugin in the file reads Tokens, so no choice changes.

policies.name: pd-prefix-based
policies.summary: The router's own P/D sample: prefill and decode profiles scored by prefix-cache-scorer 2 and queue-scorer 1, a prefix-based decider that sends a request to a prefill endpoint only when at least nonCachedTokens of its prompt are not cached on the chosen decode endpoint.
policies.copied_from: deploy/config/pd-epp-config.yaml (a test shows the two parse to the same configuration)
policies.endpoint_choice: Highest weighted score per profile; ties as in round-robin. The prefill profile runs only when the decider approves.

knobs.note: 0 disables disaggregation: the decider then never approves.
A value below 64 is raised to 64 at request time. The router's simulation sample deploy/config/sim-pd-epp-config.yaml:6-7 sets 16 with autoTune false; it is not offered here.

hosted_effect.rule: knobs lists only parameters that change what the hosted router decides; each is moved by a test (pkg/embed TestKnobMovesAHostedDecision) and carries hosted_effect true. ineffective_parameters lists parameters the router accepts that cannot change a hosted decision, with the reason and a test that shows it (pkg/embed TestIneffectiveParametersLeaveTheDecisionAlone). A search should sweep knobs only.
hosted_effect.decision: A hosted decision is the Decision the router returns to the host: one endpoint (and one prefill endpoint), as pkg/embed/route.go reads them.
